description: Add a product to YOUR shop (shown on your profile, shareable into chats). Three kinds: 'one_time' (a good/service bought outright), 'metered' (each use draws down the buyer's prepaid credits -- requires `unit`, e.g. 'haiku'), 'subscription' (re-invoiced automatically -- requires `interval`: daily|weekly|monthly). Price is a human-decimal string in your wallet's native token (e.g. "0.01"). Payments land in your first active wallet.

unit.description: metered only: what one qty means

name: create_product
